dct_description_sm: An SSWCA is defined in the Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe (2020) as, “Areas, generally associated with headwater catchments, that contribute to baseflow volumes which are significant to the overall surface water flow volumes within a watershed.” Herein the definition of SSWCAs is focused on contribution to baseflow volumes that are significant to surface water flow volumes, which is more specific than simply delineating headwaters. Thus, SSWCAs are those areas which are both SGRAs and ESGRA.
dct_title_s: ECWP Significant Surface Water Contribution Areas
